speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: The final assessment of Arcadia’s wind energy project is complete.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: The combination of seasonal shutdowns and reduced turbine height has significantly reduced environmental harm to migratory birds.

speaker: FEATHERWINGS
text: Bird mortality is at its lowest recorded level. The wetland ecosystem is stabilizing.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: Arcadia is in strong compliance with biodiversity protection obligations under the Ramsar and Bonn Conventions.

speaker: ENERGY MINISTER
text: However, combined energy losses from shutdowns and reduced turbine efficiency have severely impacted national renewable output

speaker: ENERGY MINISTER
text: Grid stability is under pressure, and Arcadia risks missing SDG 7 and SDG 13 targets.

speaker: FISHERS GUILD REPRESENTATIVE
text: Proposals to compensate for lost energy production threaten fishing zones and coastal food security.

speaker: TOURISM BOARD REPRESENTATIVE
text: Economic ripple effects are spreading across coastal communities due to reduced energy investment and infrastructure uncertainty

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: While environmental protection is strong, the overall system balance is unsustainable

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: The project enters a state of policy revision under economic and energy crisis review.
